verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਸੂਤ੍ਰ ਗਤਿ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pooran braham gur pooran param jot ot pot sootr gat ek hee anek hai ||

en.bdb: The complete Lord has permeated Himself in His creation like weft and woof of a cloth. Despite being one, He has manifested Himself into many forms. The complete light of the perfect Lord resides in the consummate Guru like weft and woof.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਚਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸ੍ਰੋਤ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਦਰਸ ਸਬਦ ਵਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਕੂਲ ਗਤਿ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: lochan sravan srot ek hee dharas sabadh vaar paar kool gat saritaa bibek hai ||

en.bdb: Although eyesight and hearing power of ears is different, yet their engrossment in divine words is alike. Just as both banks of a river are alike, so is the True Guru and the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਕਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਧਾਤੁ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਜਾਨੀਅਤ ਜਾਵਦੈਕ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan banaasapatee kanik anik dhaat paaras paras jaaneeat jaavadhaik hai ||

en.bdb: Various plants that grow near a sandalwood tree all have the fragrance of sandalwood; various metals by the touch of the Philosopher's Stone are turned into gold. In the same way, Vaheguru and the Guru are one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਜਨ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅੰਜਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ॥੨੭੭॥
verses.translit_en: giaan gur a(n)jan nira(n)jan a(n)jan bikhai dhubidhaa nivaar gurmat ek Tek hai ||277||

en.bdb: A seeker disciple of the Guru, who gets collorium of knowledge in his eyes from the True Guru, is free of all blemishes of maya even while living in it. He sheds all duality and takes refuge in the wisdom of the Guru. (277)
